name: Pulse Analytics
description: Pulse Analytics adds privacy-first web analytics to a site that uses Cloudflare Zaraz. It sets no cookies and never stores IP addresses, and the script it adds to your pages is under 3 KB.

fields.name: domain
fields.label: Domain
fields.description: Enter the domain this site is registered under in Pulse, for example example.com. If you leave it empty, the tracker uses the browser's own hostname, which is right for a site served on one domain.

fields.name: companion
fields.label: Record clicks, copies and form submits
fields.description: Enter true to load a second script that records clicks, copies and form submits. It loads as a separate request, so your pages only load it when you switch this on. Leave this empty or enter false to turn it off.

fields.name: api
fields.label: Custom API origin
fields.description: If you route events through your own proxy, enter its origin here, for example https://example.com. Enter the origin only, without a path, because the tracker adds its own. Leave this empty if you have not set up a proxy.

execute_unsafe_scripts.description: Pulse Analytics adds a <script> element to the page pointing at js.ciphera.net/script.js, plus a second one for the companion interaction script if you turn it on. The component runs no other client-side logic: it does not read or write cookies, make its own network request, or touch anything else on the page.
